title: One button to add a step: + Step here, also after the last step
boardTitle: DT348: one button to add a step, + Step here, also after the last step

opportunity.from: Coach Milan 23 November 2026, 23:50, looking at the board B165 and B166: + Add a step and + Step here are two different buttons for the same job. 23:59: Next.
opportunity.job: Write a recipe's steps: add a step where it belongs.
opportunity.kind: Two kinds of button for one job: the eye has to learn both.
opportunity.why_now: DT345 (0.3.188) added + Step here between steps; the end of the list still has the older button.

problem: Writing steps, a step between two steps comes from + Step here, a dashed button under the step. A step after the last one comes from + Add a step, a filled button of another kind and another place. Same job, two looks, two words.
story: When I write a recipe's steps, I want one button to add a step wherever it goes, so that I learn it once.
now: Edit recipe, Steps: 1, + Step here, 2, then + Add a step. The publish sheet writes steps with the same editor, so it is the same there.
proposed: + Step here after the last step too, the same dashed button, in the same place under the step; + Add a step goes. Its label for a screen reader: Add a step after step 2. Enter in a step still adds the next one. One editor (StepsEditor), so Edit recipe and the publish sheet change together.
looked_at: Keep + Add a step and make + Step here look like it: not chosen, the dashed button sits where the step will go, which is what it says.
short: + Step here after the last step too; + Add a step goes; release 0.3.197

ac.title: The same button after the last step
ac.text: Given Banana porridge with 2 steps, when I open Edit recipe, then under step 1 and under step 2 there is + Step here, the same dashed button, and there is no + Add a step

ac.title: It adds step 3
ac.text: Given that, when I tap + Step here under step 2, then step 3 opens, empty, with the cursor in it, and + Step here is under step 3

ac.title: For a screen reader
ac.text: Given 2 steps, when a screen reader reads the button under step 2, then it says Add a step after step 2

ac.title: The publish sheet
ac.text: Given the same recipe in the publish sheet, when I read its steps, then the same: + Step here between and after the last, no + Add a step

ac.title: In every language
ac.text: Given Srpski or German, when I open Edit recipe, then the button after the last step has the same words as the one between steps, and its screen reader label is in that language

unchanged: + Step here between steps (DT345), and where it adds the step.
Enter in a step adds the next step.
The foods under the steps, and the notes about foods in no step.
Start cooking and the steps as read on the recipe page.
checks: Light plus the German sweep: one component (StepsEditor) and its words. The unit tests; the build; a new walkthrough for AC1 to AC5; the six walkthroughs that tap + Add a step today (day-levels, past-and-plan, recipe-photos, steps-and-parts, explore-photo, tester-fixes) change with the story, each with a note; deutsch, language and design-rules. About 10 walkthroughs, 4 minutes. Words: steps.addAStep goes; steps.addAfter is new (Srpski and German).
details: src/components/StepsEditor.tsx: the last button is st-between st-after with steps.stepHere and the label steps.addAfter; src/index.css: .st-after keeps its width (align-self: flex-start).
The pictures: before from main, 0.3.196; new from a scratch build of main with the change, not committed. The publish sheet opens for a coach (chefmealan-coach).
